#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Regenerate fig4_bootstrap.pdf and fig5_crossmodel.pdf from hardcoded
authoritative values (paired bootstrap B=10000, single source of truth).

Source: cohens_d_bf16.json + cohens_d_bf16_qwen.json
QW s=0.15: ns (CI includes zero). All other points significant.
"""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path

OUTDIR = Path("/root/autodl-tmp/pacs/paper/figures")
OUTDIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.serif': ['DejaVu Serif'],
    'font.size': 9,
    'axes.labelsize': 10,
    'xtick.labelsize': 8,
    'ytick.labelsize': 8,
    'legend.fontsize': 8,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
})

C_DS = '#0072B2'
C_QW = '#D55E00'

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# AUTHORITATIVE DATA — hardcoded, not read from any pipeline JSON
# Source: paired bootstrap B=10000 registry
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

SPARSITY = [0.15, 0.20, 0.25, 0.30]

# DeepSeek paired d_z (n=49)
DS_DZ     = [0.4416, 0.5195, 0.6831, 0.8031]
DS_DZ_LO  = [0.3548, 0.4319, 0.5576, 0.6659]
DS_DZ_HI  = [0.7836, 0.9011, 0.8634, 1.0191]

# Qwen paired d_z (n=46)
QW_DZ     = [0.2811, 0.5494, 0.8894, 1.0220]
QW_DZ_LO  = [-0.0063, 0.2263, 0.6906, 0.8639]
QW_DZ_HI  = [0.5967, 1.0204, 1.1981, 1.3275]

# Median severity difference Δ̃ (paired)
DS_DELTA  = [0.32, 1.15, 3.97, 9.94]
DS_DCI_LO = [0.20, 0.66, 2.83, 8.39]
DS_DCI_HI = [0.47, 1.26, 5.29, 16.65]

QW_DELTA  = [0.05, 0.21, 1.11, 2.62]
QW_DCI_LO = [-0.01, 0.07, 0.61, 1.72]
QW_DCI_HI = [0.11, 0.40, 1.47, 3.65]

# QW s=0.15 is not significant (d_z CI and Δ̃ CI both include zero)
QW_NS = [True, False, False, False]


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FIG 4: Forest Plot — Paired d_z with Bootstrap 95% CI
# Single panel, both models offset vertically at each sparsity level
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
print("=== Fig 4: d_z Forest Plot ===", flush=True)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.5, 2.8))

y_base = np.arange(len(SPARSITY))
offset = 0.16

# Effect size threshold lines
for thr in [0.2, 0.5, 0.8]:
    ax.axvline(thr, color='#dddddd', lw=0.8, ls='--', zorder=1)
ax.axvline(0, color='black', lw=0.5, zorder=1)

# Threshold labels at top
for thr, label in [(0.2, 'small'), (0.5, 'medium'), (0.8, 'large')]:
    ax.text(thr, -0.65, label, fontsize=5.5, color='#999999',
            ha='center', va='bottom')

# DeepSeek (above center)
for i in range(len(SPARSITY)):
    y = y_base[i] - offset
    ax.plot([DS_DZ_LO[i], DS_DZ_HI[i]], [y, y],
            color=C_DS, lw=2.0, solid_capstyle='round', zorder=3)
    ax.plot(DS_DZ[i], y, 'D', color=C_DS, ms=5.5, zorder=4)

# Qwen (below center)
for i in range(len(SPARSITY)):
    y = y_base[i] + offset
    if QW_NS[i]:
        lc, mc, fc = '#999999', '#999999', 'white'
    else:
        lc, mc, fc = C_QW, C_QW, C_QW

    ax.plot([QW_DZ_LO[i], QW_DZ_HI[i]], [y, y],
            color=lc, lw=2.0, solid_capstyle='round', zorder=3)
    ax.plot(QW_DZ[i], y, 'D', color=mc, markerfacecolor=fc,
            markeredgecolor=mc, ms=5.5, zorder=4, markeredgewidth=1.1)

    if QW_NS[i]:
        ax.text(QW_DZ_HI[i] + 0.04, y, 'ns',
                fontsize=6.5, color='#666666', fontweight='bold',
                va='center', ha='left')

# Legend
ax.plot([], [], 'D-', color=C_DS, ms=5, lw=1.8, label='DeepSeek-R1-7B ($n{=}49$)')
ax.plot([], [], 'D-', color=C_QW, ms=5, lw=1.8, label='Qwen2.5-7B ($n{=}46$)')

ax.set_yticks(y_base)
ax.set_yticklabels([f'$s = {s:.2f}$' for s in SPARSITY])
ax.set_xlabel("Paired Cohen's $d_z$")
ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.set_xlim(-0.15, 1.45)
ax.legend(loc='lower right', frameon=True, fancybox=False,
          edgecolor='#cccccc', fontsize=6.5, borderpad=0.4)

fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(OUTDIR / 'fig4_bootstrap.pdf')
fig.savefig(OUTDIR / 'fig4_bootstrap.png')
plt.close(fig)
print("  Saved fig4_bootstrap.pdf + .png")


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FIG 5: Cross-Model Median Severity Difference (Δ̃)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
print("\n=== Fig 5: Cross-Model Δ̃ ===", flush=True)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.5, 2.8))

# DeepSeek
ax.plot(SPARSITY, DS_DELTA, '-o', color=C_DS, ms=5, lw=1.5,
        label='DeepSeek-R1-7B', zorder=5)
ax.fill_between(SPARSITY, DS_DCI_LO, DS_DCI_HI, color=C_DS, alpha=0.10)

# Qwen — line first, then markers separately for ns styling
ax.plot(SPARSITY, QW_DELTA, '--', color=C_QW, lw=1.5, zorder=4)

for i, s in enumerate(SPARSITY):
    if QW_NS[i]:
        ax.plot(s, QW_DELTA[i], '^', markerfacecolor='white',
                markeredgecolor=C_QW, ms=6, zorder=5, markeredgewidth=1.2)
    else:
        ax.plot(s, QW_DELTA[i], '^', color=C_QW, ms=5, zorder=5)

ax.fill_between(SPARSITY, QW_DCI_LO, QW_DCI_HI, color=C_QW, alpha=0.10)

# Legend proxy for Qwen
ax.plot([], [], '--^', color=C_QW, ms=5, lw=1.5, label='Qwen2.5-7B')

# Annotate d_z near each point
for i, s in enumerate(SPARSITY):
    # DeepSeek annotations (above point)
    y_ds = DS_DELTA[i]
    ax.annotate(f'$d_z$={DS_DZ[i]:.2f}',
                xy=(s, y_ds),
                xytext=(4, 6), textcoords='offset points',
                fontsize=5.5, color=C_DS, ha='left')

    # Qwen annotations (below point for clarity)
    y_qw = QW_DELTA[i]
    if QW_NS[i]:
        label_txt = f'$d_z$={QW_DZ[i]:.2f} (ns)'
        col = '#999999'
    else:
        label_txt = f'$d_z$={QW_DZ[i]:.2f}'
        col = C_QW
    ax.annotate(label_txt,
                xy=(s, y_qw),
                xytext=(4, -10), textcoords='offset points',
                fontsize=5.5, color=col, ha='left')

ax.set_xlabel('Sparsity Level ($s$)')
ax.set_ylabel('Median Severity Diff. $\\widetilde{\\Delta}$')
ax.set_xticks(SPARSITY)
ax.set_xlim(0.13, 0.32)
ax.legend(loc='upper left', frameon=True, fancybox=False,
          edgecolor='#cccccc', fontsize=7, borderpad=0.3)

fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(OUTDIR / 'fig5_crossmodel.pdf')
fig.savefig(OUTDIR / 'fig5_crossmodel.png')
plt.close(fig)
print("  Saved fig5_crossmodel.pdf + .png")

# ── Verify output ──
print("\n=== Output files ===")
for f in sorted(OUTDIR.iterdir()):
    if f.name.startswith(('fig4_', 'fig5_')):
        print(f"  {f.name}  ({f.stat().st_size / 1024:.1f} KB)")
print("\nDONE")
